digest.component_or_area: completion evidence banking observer and oracle
propositions: The test observer's actor filter (source=="tool") is stale and causes the 0707 eval to fail despite system-level banking boundedness being maintained by policy fallbacks.
The banking observer must record the first durable write of each criterion regardless of source (genuine model records OR policy fallback snapshots), excluding cache seeds marked seeded=True.
A system where the policy provides per-criterion 3-response fallback snapshots (bounded-gap oracle unchanged at max_gap=3) must pass when the oracle counts all durable writes regardless of actor.
Live run 32575679530 proved the system bound holds (fallbacks at responses 2/5/8, gaps ≤3) but the model's first genuine bank at response 6 fails the old actor-filtered contract.
